name: Real-Time Streaming & Event Processing
description: Real-time event stream processing using Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Kafka Streams, Schema Registry, event time watermarks, stream windowing, and exactly-once semantics.

subskills.name: Kafka Cluster Architecture, Topics & Partitions
subskills.description: Brokers, Controller / KRaft mode (KRaft vs ZooKeeper), topic partition distribution, replication factor, ISR (In-Sync Replicas), and leader election.

subskills.name: Producers, Consumers & Consumer Group Rebalancing
subskills.description: Producer acks (0, 1, all), batch size, linger.ms, consumer groups, partition assignment strategies (Range, RoundRobin, CooperativeSticky), and commit offsets.

subskills.name: Confluent Schema Registry & Schema Evolution
subskills.description: Schema Registry integration, Avro / Protobuf serialization, schema compatibility modes (BACKWARD, FORWARD, FULL), and preventing schema drift.

subskills.name: Kafka Streams & ksqlDB Stream Processing
subskills.description: KStream, KTable, GlobalKTable, stateless vs stateful operations, RocksDB state stores, and real-time SQL stream analysis with ksqlDB.

subskills.name: Apache Flink Architecture & Stateful Stream Processing
subskills.description: JobManager, TaskManager, slots, DataStream API, stateful transformations (ValueState, ListState, MapState), and Flink SQL.

subskills.name: Event Time, Processing Time & Watermarks
subskills.description: Event Time vs Processing Time vs Ingestion Time, watermark generation strategies (bounded-out-of-orderness, punctuated), and handling late-arriving records with side outputs.

subskills.name: Stream Windowing (Tumbling, Sliding, Session)
subskills.description: Tumbling windows (fixed, non-overlapping), Sliding/Hopping windows (overlapping), Session windows (gap-based), and custom window triggers/evictors.

subskills.name: Exactly-Once Semantics (EOS) & Two-Phase Commit
subskills.description: At-least-once vs At-most-once vs Exactly-Once (EOS), transactional producers, Two-Phase Commit (2PC) sinks in Flink/Kafka, and idempotent writes.

subskills.name: State Backends, Checkpointing & Savepoints
subskills.description: Flink state backends (HashMapStateBackend, EmbeddedRocksDBStateBackend), Chandy-Lamport distributed checkpointing, unaligned checkpoints, and manual savepoints.

cv.signal: Engineered real-time streaming pipelines using Kafka, Schema Registry, and Apache Flink

linkedin.signal: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka (CCDAK)

assessment.signal: Passes Real-Time Event Streaming & Stream Processing Architecture Assessment

junior.description: Produces and consumes messages from Kafka topics, avoids basic consumer lag, and enforces schema registry Avro schemas.

mid.description: Develops stream applications with Kafka Streams / ksqlDB, defines watermarks for out-of-order records, and implements tumbling/sliding time windows.

senior.description: Architects end-to-end Exactly-Once stateful stream pipelines using Apache Flink, tunes RocksDB state backends, and designs zero-downtime savepoint upgrades.
